acceptance_criteria.criterion: php tools/populate-index.php runs without errors against all registered comics
--force / -f flag causes existing values to be overwritten
--comic=<alias> limits execution to the specified comic; all others are skipped
Invalid --comic alias prints an error to STDERR and exits with code 1
Comics with no index.json are skipped with a [SKIP] notice
A summary line is printed at the end: processed / skipped / entries updated
Exit code is 0 on success, 1 on fatal error
No PHPStan errors at level 5 for this file

summary: Parses $argv: --force/-f and --comic=<alias>, rejects unknown args with exit(1)
Invalid --comic alias prints error to STDERR, exit(1)
Skips comics without index via $comic->hasIndex() with [SKIP] notice
Prints summary: Processed: N, Skipped: N, Entries updated: N
Exit code 0 on success, 1 on error
Tested: all 50 comics processed (exit 0), --comic=bookwyrms filters correctly, --force re-populates 379 entries, invalid alias exits 1
All 9 acceptance criteria met. CLI tool tested: all comics, filtered, force, invalid alias, unknown args. All exit codes correct. PHPStan level 5 clean.

comments.note: CLI tested: (1) no args → 50 comics processed, exit 0. (2) --comic=bookwyrms --force → 1 comic, 379 entries updated, exit 0. (3) -f shorthand → works. (4) --comic=nonexistent → STDERR error, exit 1. (5) --bogus → STDERR error with usage, exit 1. Summary line format matches spec. PHPStan level 5: 0 errors.

summary: Code review passed. CLI script is clean, well-structured, and correctly delegates to IndexPopulator. Argument parsing handles --force/-f, --comic=alias, and rejects unknowns. STDERR/STDOUT separation is correct. Error handling spot-checked with invalid alias (exit 1 confirmed). PHPStan level 5 clean. All 9 acceptance criteria confirmed met.

comments.note: Clean CLI script. Well-documented header with usage. Proper STDERR/STDOUT separation. No framework coupling. Argument parsing handles all edge cases (unknown args, invalid alias). Spot-checked: --comic=nonexistent correctly exits 1 with error on STDERR. PHPStan level 5 clean.

summary: tools/populate-index.php has comprehensive file-level PHPDoc: purpose, usage syntax, option descriptions, exit codes.
